'''March 2001 Modesto tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Modesto, California on 24 March 2001. [[Paul McKelvey]] won it. It is known from Paul McKelvey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1948">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-modesto-california-3-24-01d1948/ modesto-california-3-24-01], DeckTech (Paul "Dark Raptor" McKelvey, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-modesto-california-3-24-01d1948/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Modesto, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul McKelvey]]
